units.title: Les préfixes qui changent le sens

words.eg: It is {unlikely} to be ready before Easter.
The chart was {misleading} without being wrong.
We {overestimated} how many people would come and ate leftovers for a week.
Never {underestimate} how long the last ten per cent takes.
That gives us a fortnight to {rethink} the whole thing.
Half the objections were {irrelevant} and took most of the hour.
He gets {impatient} about the third time you explain it.
You can {disagree} without turning it into a fight.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces préfixes disent « non ». Lequel dit « à nouveau » ?
odd.why: re- refait ; un-, ir- et im- nient.

units.title: Les suffixes qui font des noms

words.eg: Small acts of {kindness} are what makes a street liveable.
words.clue: -ness prend un adjectif et en fait une qualité.

words.eg: It is an {improvement} on last year, which is not saying much.
We came to an {arrangement} that suits nobody perfectly.
A {friendship} made in the first month rarely survives the first year.
Your {employer} has to give it to you in writing.
Every {employee} gets the same letter and reads it differently.
words.clue: -er fait celui qui agit, -ee celui qui subit.

words.eg: {Membership} costs forty pounds and includes the newsletter nobody reads.
There is one {assistant} for the whole floor and she runs it.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces noms désignent une personne. Lequel désigne une qualité ?
odd.why: La gentillesse ne se serre pas la main.

units.title: Les suffixes qui font des adjectifs

words.eg: Nothing within a mile of here is {affordable} on one salary.
I am {hopeless} at names and always have been.
It was a {thoughtful} thing to do and she did not mention it.
It is {risky} and it is also the only option left.
Split it in three and it becomes {manageable}.
Refusing to reply is {childish} and everyone can see it.
words.clue: -ish colle souvent un reproche : childish n’est pas childlike.

words.eg: The {creative} bit takes an afternoon and the rest takes a month.
The meeting was {endless} and decided nothing.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces adjectifs sont négatifs. Lequel est un compliment ?
odd.why: « Thoughtful » loue quelqu’un qui a pensé aux autres.

words.eg: The {car park} charges by the hour and never has a space.

no.a parking: « Parking » tout seul n’est pas un nom en anglais : c’est « a car park ».

words.eg: The {traffic warden} comes at nine and again at two.
The {washing machine} is in the kitchen, as it is in every British house.
There is a {dishwasher} and nobody has ever loaded it correctly.
Two hours of that spreadsheet and I had a {headache}.
A {haircut} here costs what a meal costs at home.
Friday is a {takeaway} and nobody argues.
He said it with the calm of a man who has passed a {lie detector}.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces noms composés sont des machines. Lequel est un symptôme ?
odd.why: Le mal de tête n’a pas de prise de courant.
